meta.title: 年前离职要不要等年终奖？分情况考虑
meta.title_en: Should You Wait for the Year-End Bonus Before Switching?

scenes.title_en: The Bonus You Haven't Gotten Yet
scenes.context: 讲者设定场景：年前跳槽，原公司年终奖还没发。
sentences: 年前考虑跳槽换工作，年终奖还没发。
You're thinking of switching jobs, but the year-end bonus hasn't been paid.
年终奖：year-end bonus
到底是走还是留？
Should you leave or stay?
走还是留：leave or stay
这要分情况来看。
It depends on the situation.
分情况：it depends
paraphrase: 年终奖 → 跳槽时机的变量
The bonus is a variable in your timing decision.
Leaving or staying depends on the specifics.
scenes.speak: You're thinking of switching jobs, but the year-end bonus hasn't been paid. Should you leave or stay? It depends on the situation.

scenes.context: 讲者按年终奖金额大小给出两种选择。
sentences: 如果年终奖金额比较高，这部分钱值得等。
If the bonus is substantial, it's worth waiting for.
金额比较高：substantial
建议你拿到手再走。
Wait until it hits your account before you leave.
拿到手：hit your account
金额不大，不值得为这点钱耽误。
If it's small, don't delay your move over a little money.
不值得耽误：not worth the delay
paraphrase: 金额高 → 时间换收入
A big bonus is worth trading time for.
Don't let a small bonus hold your career hostage.
scenes.speak: If the bonus is substantial, it's worth waiting for. Wait until it hits your account before you leave. If it's small, don't delay your move over a little money.

scenes.context: 讲者提醒年终奖单独计税红利到 2023 年底，晚于此时入职要确认计税方式。
sentences: 年终奖单独计税的政策红利到 2023 年年底为止。
The separate tax treatment for year-end bonuses ends in late 2023.
单独计税：separate tax treatment
如果晚于这个时间入职新的公司。
If you join a new company after that point.
入职：join a new company
需要和 HR 确认清楚年终奖的计税方式。
Confirm the bonus tax method with HR to avoid overpaying.
计税方式：tax method
paraphrase: 政策有时效 → 计税方式会变
Tax policy changes over time—know the method.
入职前 → 先确认再签约
Confirm before you sign, not after.
scenes.speak: The separate tax treatment for year-end bonuses ends in late 2023. If you join a new company after that point. Confirm the bonus tax method with HR to avoid overpaying.

practice: I'm waiting for the year-end bonus before I hand in my notice.
I'll leave once the bonus hits my account.
How will the year-end bonus be taxed at your company?
I want to make sure I don't overpay on taxes.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：The year-end money is not sent.
✓ 地道说法：The year-end bonus hasn't been paid out yet.
年终奖用 year-end bonus，发放是 paid out。
✕ 直译腔：This money is worth waiting.
✓ 地道说法：This bonus is substantial enough to wait for.
值得等用 worth waiting for。
✕ 直译腔：Don't delay for this little money.
✓ 地道说法：Don't put off your move over a small bonus.
为小钱耽误用 put off over a small bonus。
✕ 直译腔：Confirm the tax method with HR.
✓ 地道说法：Ask HR how the bonus will be taxed.
确认计税方式用 how it will be taxed 更口语。
shifts: 把年终奖与税负一起算
footer_notes: ASR 校正：原文「个人所得税收政策」按语境理解为年终奖单独计税政策，作口语补充说明；「个税」按语境保留。2023 年底的时效信息以视频表述为准。场景/句子朗读使用 edge-tts，单词发音使用浏览器 Web Speech API。
